ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your image and your personal energy. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on rest and your inner life. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your career and your goals. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on relationships and partnerships. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on routine, daily work and health. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on home and family. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The Sun and Neptune are together in {S:0}: willpower and visibility, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your money and what you value. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.
